metadata.description: Complete honeymoon-match quiz data for production deployment

quiz.title: Honeymoon Match
quiz.description: Great honeymoons start with knowing your style. Your Honeymoon Match reveals the way you and your partner love to travel - and the most magical ways to celebrate your new chapter together. Once we know your honeymoon style, we'll connect you with a Fora advisor who can design a trip made just for you.

inputs.label: 1. It's more meaningful to us when…
inputs.name: q1

options.label: We conquer a hike together to an epic view
We check into a breathtaking luxury suite overlooking the ocean
We share a home-cooked meal with locals

inputs.label: 2. On our honeymoon, we'd rather start the day with…
inputs.name: q2

results.name: Adventure Honeymooners
results.description: You and your partner are thrill-seekers who believe the best honeymoon memories come from conquering new challenges together. From hiking to hidden waterfalls to diving in crystal-clear waters, you want your honeymoon to be an adventure story you'll tell for years to come.
results.advisorDescription: Find an advisor who specializes in creating unforgettable adventure honeymoons with the perfect mix of excitement and romance.

results.name: Luxe Seekers
results.description: Your honeymoon is the ultimate indulgence. For you, it’s about private villas with plunge pools, champagne at sunset, and every detail taken care of before you even think to ask. Romance is found in flawless service, endless pampering, and once-in-a-lifetime upgrades that make your honeymoon shine.
results.advisorDescription: Find a Fora advisor who can unlock exclusive perks, insider access, and the kind of five-star experiences that will set your honeymoon apart.

results.name: Immersive Locals
results.description: Your honeymoon is about more than just being there — it’s about belonging. You crave neighborhood cafés where no one speaks English, local festivals where you’re swept into the crowd, and conversations that last late into the night with new friends. For you, romance is found in connection and cultural discovery.
results.travelStyle: Authentic local experiences and cultural immersion
results.advisorDescription: Find a Fora advisor who can take you beyond the guidebook and into the heart of your honeymoon destination.

results.name: Gastronomes
results.description: For you, love is best celebrated at the table. Your honeymoon memories will live in flavor: the first bite of street food that blows you away, a cooking class where you laugh your way through learning, or a Michelin-star dinner that becomes a story you’ll retell forever. Every meal is part of your love story.
results.advisorDescription: Find a Fora advisor who can secure the tables, tastings, and culinary experiences that will make your honeymoon deliciously unforgettable.

results.name: Wellness Seekers
results.description: Your dream honeymoon is about slowing down, recharging, and reconnecting with each other. Whether it’s couples’ yoga at sunrise, soaking in hot springs surrounded by nature, or indulging in spa rituals that melt away the stress of wedding planning, you travel to restore as much as to explore.
results.advisorDescription: Find a Fora advisor who can guide you to the most transformative retreats and serene escapes — the perfect setting for your new chapter together.

results.name: Chameleons
results.description: You're a rare mix. On your honeymoon, you can flow effortlessly from poolside champagne to a bustling market to a hidden trattoria — all in the same day. You're versatile, curious, and open to celebrating your love in every way possible.
results.travelStyle: Dynamic experiences that blend luxury, culture, adventure, and wellness
results.advisorDescription: Find a Fora advisor who can design a honeymoon as dynamic and multifaceted as the two of you.

content.title: Patagonia
content.description: Remote glaciers, turquoise lakes, and wide-open skies make Patagonia feel like the edge of the world. For honeymooners, it's a place of epic hikes, glacier treks, and nights spent under star-studded skies. This is adventure at its most awe-inspiring, where nature feels infinite and untamed.

content.title: Tierra Patagonia
content.description: An immersive lodge with panoramic views of Torres del Paine, perfect for combining adventure-filled days with spa relaxation and cozy nights by the fire.

content.title: Newfoundland, Canada
content.description: Rugged North Atlantic coastlines, quiet fishing villages, and windswept beauty set the scene for a honeymoon that feels both adventurous and deeply peaceful. Couples can kayak along iceberg-studded waters, hike dramatic coastal trails, and immerse themselves in the island's rich culture.

content.title: Fogo Island Inn
content.description: A striking design hotel perched on the rocks, offering floor-to-ceiling ocean views and a strong connection to the local community

content.title: New Zealand (South Island)
content.description: From fjords and glaciers to rolling vineyards, New Zealand's South Island is a natural playground. Honeymooners can mix thrill-seeking—think bungee jumps and heli-hikes—with slow moments of serenity, surrounded by landscapes that are cinematic in scale.

content.title: Rosewood Matakauri
content.description: A lakeside retreat near Queenstown where every suite offers sweeping alpine views and a sense of secluded luxury.

content.title: Lake Como, Italy
content.description: Timeless glamour meets lakeside romance on the shores of Como. Private boat rides, candlelit dinners overlooking the water, and storied villas make this one of the most iconic honeymoon destinations in the world. It's where elegance feels effortless, and every view is postcard-perfect.

content.title: Grand Hotel Tremezzo
content.description: An art nouveau palace with floating pools, lush gardens, and suites designed for indulgent romance.

content.title: South Africa, Safari
content.description: A honeymoon safari means waking to birdsong, setting out on thrilling game drives, and watching elephants roam as the sun sets. It's wild luxury at its finest, blending awe-inspiring adventure with the comforts of private lodges and world-class service.

content.title: Royal Malewane
content.description: An intimate safari lodge offering unmatched game-viewing, sumptuous suites, and the kind of personalized service that makes every moment feel special.

content.title: St. Barths, Caribbean
content.description: Chic and playful, St. Barths combines French sophistication with Caribbean ease. Days are spent between glamorous beach clubs, boutique shopping, and secluded coves, while evenings bring fine dining under the stars. For honeymooners, it's pure island indulgence.

content.title: Cheval Blanc St-Barth
content.description: A beachfront boutique property offering understated elegance, exceptional dining, and true barefoot luxury.

content.title: Kyoto, Japan
content.description: Kyoto’s lantern-lit alleys, serene temples, and quiet tea ceremonies invite couples to slow down and savor each moment. Here, your honeymoon becomes a journey into Japanese tradition, with every meal, shrine visit, and garden walk layered in history and beauty.

content.title: HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO
content.description: A refined property built around an original 300-year-old gate, offering onsen baths and an atmosphere of timeless elegance.

content.title: Marrakech, Morocco
content.description: Vibrant souks, hidden riads, and the hum of daily life fill Marrakech with color and energy. For honeymooners, the city is intoxicating — a blend of romance, culture, and sensory adventure. By day, wander spice-scented markets; by night, retreat to serene courtyards.

content.title: Royal Mansour
content.description: A palatial property built by Moroccan artisans, with private riads and world-class service that redefines luxury.

content.title: Cusco & Sacred Valley, Peru
content.description: A honeymoon here means wandering cobblestone streets, exploring vibrant markets, and standing in awe of ancient Incan sites. The Sacred Valley invites couples to connect with Andean traditions while surrounded by breathtaking mountain landscapes.

content.title: Monasterio, A Belmond Hotel
content.description: A former 16th-century monastery transformed into a romantic retreat filled with history, art, and charm.

content.title: San Sebastián, Spain
content.description: Few places in the world celebrate food quite like San Sebastián. Honeymooners can spend days hopping pintxo bars, indulging in Michelin-starred dining, and sipping wine by the sea. Here, every meal feels like a celebration.

content.title: Akelarre – Relais & Châteaux
content.description: A destination hotel with a three-Michelin-starred restaurant, set against sweeping views of the Bay of Biscay.

content.title: Bangkok, Thailand
content.description: From sizzling street food stalls to cutting-edge fine dining, Bangkok is a feast for all the senses. Couples can dive into bustling markets, cruise along the Chao Phraya River, and discover flavors that linger long after the honeymoon.

content.title: Capella Bangkok
content.description: A riverside sanctuary where contemporary luxury meets authentic Thai hospitality.

content.title: Mexico City, Mexico
content.description: A capital alive with energy, Mexico City blends vibrant street tacos with award-winning restaurants. A honeymoon here means exploring colorful neighborhoods, sipping mezcal, and tasting your way through one of the world’s most exciting culinary scenes.

content.title: Casa Polanco
content.description: A chic boutique hotel in leafy Polanco, offering stylish comfort just steps from the city’s best dining.

content.title: Douro Valley, Portugal
content.description: Rolling vineyards and river views create a haven of calm in Portugal’s wine country. Honeymooners can sip vintages, take slow river cruises, and reset with holistic spa treatments in a serene setting.

content.title: Six Senses Douro Valley
content.description: A wellness-focused resort blending wine culture with transformative spa experiences.

content.title: Ubud, Bali
content.description: Nestled in lush jungle, Ubud is the spiritual heart of Bali. Couples can practice yoga at sunrise, visit sacred temples, and reconnect with nature in a place that feels designed for reflection and renewal.

content.title: Capella Ubud
content.description: A luxury tented retreat offering jungle seclusion and immersive wellness experiences.

content.title: Swiss Alps (Lake Lucerne)
content.description: Crisp alpine air and panoramic lake views set the stage for relaxation and rejuvenation. Here, wellness is woven into every moment, from thermal spa rituals to mountain walks.

content.title: Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne
content.description: A legendary mountaintop resort with one of the world’s most iconic infinity pools.

content.title: The Dolomites, Italy
content.description: Jagged peaks, alpine meadows, and crisp mountain air make the Dolomites a dream for couples who want it all. Here, adventure blends seamlessly with relaxation, offering breathtaking hikes by day and spa indulgence by night.

content.title: Forestis
content.description: A serene hideaway high in the mountains, with holistic wellness and uninterrupted views.

content.title: Hawaii (Big Island)
content.description: Volcanic landscapes, lush rainforests, and black-sand beaches make the Big Island endlessly diverse. A honeymoon here offers adventure, wellness, and romance all at once — from snorkeling with manta rays to stargazing atop Mauna Kea.

content.title: Mauna Lani, Auberge Resorts Collection
content.description: A beachfront resort rooted in Hawaiian culture, with a focus on wellness and connection to nature.

left.alt: Palacio Duhau – Park Hyatt Buenos Aires

content.title: Buenos Aires, Argentina
content.description: A city alive with passion, Buenos Aires is perfect for couples who love variety. Days can be spent exploring European-style boulevards, indulging in world-class cuisine, and sipping Malbec, while nights are filled with tango and lively energy.

content.title: Palacio Duhau – Park Hyatt Buenos Aires
content.description: A Belle Époque palace with modern touches, offering an elegant base in the heart of the city.
